beats.text: Your diffusion models are choking on their own math, wasting cycles because they process every single pixel in total isolation.
beats.visual_focus: A grid of pixels flickering in and out of sync, showing massive red latency bars.

beats.text: It is like a multi-lane highway where every car is forced to stop at a single toll booth, ignoring the traffic flow around it.
beats.visual_focus: A 3D highway animation where cars pile up at a single narrow gate.

beats.text: Enter E-MoE: it replaces the bottleneck with an expert-routing layer that dispatches tokens to specialized circuits, capturing global correlations without adding parameters.
beats.visual_focus: A neural network graph splitting into color-coded expert paths dynamically.
